title: Nanak's Mind Is Imbued With The Lotus
summary: The shabad does not leave restlessness at diagnosis. It turns toward return.
takeaway: Nanak's mind is imbued with the Lotus Feet of the Lord
lifeApplication: Choose better placement before choosing more movement. After the reaction, make the next return smaller and truer.

source.shortMeaning: Through devotional worship of the Lord, and service to the Guru, one; nanak's mind is imbued with the Lotus Feet of the Lord
source.lifeApplication: Return begins when the later line is allowed to outlast the first rush of feeling.
